name: Courtyard by Marriott Paris Gare de Lyon
description:
On a bustling commercial road in the city center, this modern hotel is 5 km from the Louvre Museum and a 3-minute walk from Gare de Lyon train station.
Chic rooms feature flat-screen TVs, and tea and coffeemaking facilities; some add city views. Family rooms sleep up to 4 guests. Wi-Fi is available for a fee.
There's a restaurant/bar and a fitness center. Parking and breakfast are offered (surcharge). A security deposit is required.

user_review.comment: Excellent location, very nice clean rooms and quiet, rooms have all expect amenities which was great. Restaurant and front desk staff are really nice, service is very good. Food was lovely, hotel is very practical and reasonably priced.
No AC in the middle of the hottest period in Paris. When you raise up the issue they give you a fan. Thats it.

user_review.comment: Great location to train station and sites and wonderful restaurants. Close to the Luxembourg gardens and the botanical  Gardens.  Bathroom and closing glass. There was a gap in the toilet door which did not provide much privacy and Front desk could not repair it.
